001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.controller;
002
003import android.os.Bundle;
004import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
005import androidx.navigation.NavController;
006import androidx.navigation.fragment.NavHostFragment;
007import androidx.navigation.ui.AppBarConfiguration;
008import androidx.navigation.ui.NavigationUI;
009import dagger.hilt.android.AndroidEntryPoint;
010import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.R;
011import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.databinding.ActivityMainBinding;
012
013@AndroidEntryPoint
014public class MainActivity extends AppCompatActivity {
015
016
017  private ActivityMainBinding binding;
018  private NavController navController;
019  private AppBarConfiguration appBarConfig;
020
021  @Override
022  protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
023    super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
024    binding = ActivityMainBinding.inflate(getLayoutInflater());
025    setContentView(binding.getRoot());
026    //Adding our own toolbar
027    setupNavigation();
028  }
029
030  @Override
031  public boolean onSupportNavigateUp() {
032    return NavigationUI.navigateUp(navController, appBarConfig);
033  }
034
035  private void setupNavigation() {
036    setSupportActionBar(binding.toolbar);
037    appBarConfig = new AppBarConfiguration.Builder(R.id.home_fragment, R.id.pre_login_fragment, R.id.login_fragment)
038        .build();
039    navController =((NavHostFragment) binding.navHostContainer.getFragment()).getNavController();
040    NavigationUI.setupActionBarWithNavController(this, navController, appBarConfig);
041  }
042
